svg.title: MUJ source connectivity diagnostic
svg.desc: Numbered coloured components are prepared paths. Dashed red paths are excluded raw OSM geometry requiring review, not routable proposals. No basemap or proximity joins.
svg.text: Colour + C number: retained component · red dashed: EXCLUDED source path, review only · north ↑
WGS84 [longitude, latitude] · visual latitude correction only · no survey, access or accessibility verification
